text: The Elowitz and Leibler oscillator built from three repressors (TetR, cI, and LacI) arranged in a cyclic negative feedback loop, each repressing the next in the ring, is called the ___.
explanation: This synthetic oscillator is called the repressilator (Elowitz & Leibler, 2000), the founding example of an engineered genetic oscillator built from three repressors in a closed inhibitory ring. Its period is a few hours, and later work (e.g., Stricker et al. 2008, Danino et al. 2010) improved its robustness and synchronization across cell populations.
